'''Lieber''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Queensguard]] of [[House Panteer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Lieber was stationed at the [[Panteer hideout]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. An Imperial spacer recovered the [[Panteer crown]] from a nearby river and delivered it to him.<ref name="The Head" />
